intro.title: SAT Math — full practice test
intro.lead: Built like the real SAT: 2 modules of 22 questions, 35 minutes each. Module 2 gets harder or easier based on module 1.
intro.note: The result is an estimated score (200–800), not an official SAT score.
intro.rule1: No pausing inside a module — the clock keeps running.
intro.rule2: A 10-minute break between modules (you can skip it).
intro.rule3: Flag questions (🚩) to come back to them.
intro.rule4: Answers and explanations appear only after the test.

module.title: Module {n} of 2
module.question: Question {n} of {total}
module.confirm: Finish this module? You can't come back to it.
module.timeUp: Time is up — sending your answers…

break.title: Break
break.lead: Drink some water and stretch. Module 2 starts automatically.

late: Time had run out, so this module's answers were not counted.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

practice.title: Practice tests
practice.lead: Full-length tests built like Bluebook: module 1, then a harder or easier module 2 based on how you did. Every question is an original Suprep question.
practice.name: Practice Test {n}

random.title: Random mock test
random.lead: A new test drawn from the question bank — different questions every time.

official.title: Official Bluebook tests
official.lead: Take College Board's real full-length practice tests for free in the Bluebook app.
official.step1: Install Bluebook on your computer or tablet and sign in with your College Board account.
official.step2: Pick a full-length practice test under “Practice and Prepare” and take it timed, like the real exam.
official.step3: Check your score in My Practice, then review the topics you missed on the Suprep roadmap.
